newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - July 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - July 24.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The chief of staff of the UAE armed forces, Lt General Sheikh Mohammad bin Zaid al-Nahayan, arrived in Washington, DC, on Wednesday at the invitation of U.S. Defence Secretary William Cohen.

- A 235 million dirham contract has been awarded for the turnkey construction of five water desalination plants in the northern emirates. The contract was signed by the UAE with an unnamed private company.
- The UAE and the United States on Wednesday began joint military exercises aimed at boosting military coordination. The wargames, codenamed "Iron Magic '97", will last until August 4.
- Ras al-Khaimah International Airport is planning a major expansion for handling passengers and freight. The plan would lift arrivals hall capacity to 1,000 passengers.
- The Pentagon told Congress Saudi Arabia was seeking to buy arms -- including cannons and machine guns -- worth $1 billion.
